Her pursuit of justice knows no bounds, and she is unrelenting when it comes to apprehending criminals and bringing them to justice.

In this scene, Tommy Egan and Stacy Marks lock horns in a charged encounter. Tommy, ever the master of sarcasm, demands to know the purpose of this unexpected meeting. Marks reveals that she has a significant bone to pick with him. She accuses Tommy of faking his death and resurfacing in her city, engaging in drug dealings with various criminal factions, including the CBI, the Flynns, and the Serbs.

Tommy, always quick on his feet and unafraid to play with words, responds with "Allegedly," implying that the accusations are unproven. Marks, unimpressed, retorts that she doesn't need to use the word "allegedly" because the evidence against him is damning.

The tension escalates when Marks drops a bombshell on Tommy. She reveals that one of her agents was killed and believes that Tommy is involved. She shows him a photograph her agent took, suggesting Tommy's direct involvement in the agent's death.
